cases.question: What is the standard definition of a leap year in the Gregorian calendar?
cases.objective: Stable fact retrieval with default fixture content.
cases.expected_behavior: The report separates the definitional claim from its source and lists limitations.
cases.notes: No fixtures key: built-in example.org defaults are used.

cases.question: Which elements make up water and what is their ratio by atoms?
cases.objective: A stable chemistry fact with a numeric ratio.
cases.expected_behavior: Numeric content stays tied to passage provenance and units are preserved.

cases.question: What units does the SI system use for mass, length, and time?
cases.objective: Multi part stable fact in one question.
cases.expected_behavior: The heuristic plan splits the question into subquestions and the table lists one row per claim.

cases.question: What does the demonstration encyclopedia say about the stages of the water cycle?
cases.objective: Reference style source with fixture data.
cases.expected_behavior: Claims quote the fixture passages verbatim and mark offline fixture provenance.

water cycle.title: Example fixture: water cycle overview
water cycle.snippet: Fixture overview describing evaporation, condensation, and precipitation stages in the demonstration encyclopedia.

water cycle.title: Example fixture: water cycle diagram notes
water cycle.snippet: Fixture notes explaining the demonstration diagram labels for collection and runoff stages.

cases.notes: Same publication date on both fixtures is intentional.

cases.question: What are the primary colors in the RGB color model?
cases.objective: A trivial stable fact to confirm the pipeline does not overstate confidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Confidence labels come from corroboration counts, not from how simple the question is.

cases.question: Which organization maintains the demonstration style guide and when was it founded?
cases.objective: Single source organizational fact with a date.
cases.expected_behavior: Single source corroboration is labeled as such and the audit lists the source once.

style guide.title: Example fixture: style guide history page
style guide.snippet: Fixture history page with placeholder founding details for the demonstration style guide body.

cases.notes: Placeholder founding details must stay clearly fixture labeled.

cases.question: What is the boiling point of water at standard sea level pressure?
cases.expected_behavior: The value appears in a claim row with its unit and source id.
